# CONFORMANCE

The conformance ID register. Every test name ends in its ID; a test whose
ID is not listed here fails `cargo xtask check-model`, and so does an ID
listed here with no scenario and no test (`CM-02`).

The three honesty levels (R2):

| Level | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `some-true` | A fact reproduced from an authority. **Not established here.** |
| `build` | Constructed here and validated against its oracle. Evidence, not a proof. |
| `open` | Measured and reported. **Never asserted.** |

`cargo xtask audit-limits` fails if any code path returns an error the
model does not sanction.

## dest

| ID | Level | Statement |

| `DS-01` | `build` | The Prism routes an item to a destination only as PrismDest answers: nothing leaves without the owner's act on the very words they saw, nothing coercive is carried out or pushed into the owner's view, nothing without a cause is routed, restricted content never leaves, quiet is kept, and the kill switch stops every route |
| `DS-02` | `build` | The page hands an item to the owner's calendar, mail or another platform only after the Boundary and PrismDest answer deliver for the owner's press, through an app the owner already uses, with no host called and no setup |

## kappa

| ID | Level | Statement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `KP-01` | `build` | The Prism reads a kappa label as UOR-Foundation/kappa-registry's Kappa::parse does and admits an object under it only when the proved Prism Kappa decision says admit: a label without its colon, on an unknown axis, of the wrong digit count or not in lowercase hex is refused with its own answer, and bytes that do not re-derive, collide on SHA-1 or could not be re-derived are never admitted |
